notes.title: Performance Update
notes.notes:
Fixes: 
-High CPU usage, and performance issues
-Inspect items not showing
-GPU performance
-Invisible Cats
-Level streaming optimizations


Thank you for your support, and hope you continue to do so. If you have issues, be sure to inform us!

notes.title: Performance/Interaction not working
notes.notes:
In the demo, we have some performance troubles that we will be tackling. We hope anyone who tries it out and cant run it smoothly, will give it a shot again down the line. We have a few ideas to implement, that will help performance, and hope to get patches out as soon as we can to make the game all around more performance friendly for anyone. Thank you for your time and willingness. 

For the interactions, it was brought to our attention, and it seems like the inventory is blocking interactions from functioning. Just a heads up that a fix is being made for this and if you experience this issue, avoiding the inventory for now may be the solution for you.
